description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, allowing you to put a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
If you put a creature card onto the battlefield, when it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
